baptism-with-the-holy-spirit: It was a great turning point in my ministry when, after much thought, study, and meditation, I became convinced that the Baptism with the Holy Spirit was an experience for today and for me, and I set about obtaining it. Such a blessing came to me personally that I began giving Bible readings on the subject, and with increasing frequency as the years have passed.
feasting-at-the-table: This book is based on a series of lectures the author gave at the Summer School at Capernwray, Australia, in 1995. He has been encouraged to expand his notes into this book so that they might be made available to a wider audience.
grace-for-grace-2: In this powerful book, Watchman Nee uses parables like the Prodigal Son to address deep questions about grace. Through relatable scenarios, he shows how grace is vital in our journey with Christ, reminding us of the abundant grace God has already made available for us to overcome sin and experience true freedom in Him.
he-holds-my-tomorrows: This book delves into the true meaning of faith, addressing common misconceptions and exploring scriptural definitions and distinctions like the ‘work of faith’ and ‘walk of faith.’ Through biblical examples and an examination of different kinds of faith—Saving Faith, Fruit of Faith, and the Gift of Faith—it aims to illuminate how faith functions in a believer’s life. Contents: Controversy—Three Kinds of Faith—Walking by Faith—Hearing God’s Voice—Hebrews 11—Cain and Abel—Enoch—Noah—Abraham—Sarah—The Confession of Faith—Abraham Tested—Isaac and Jacob—Joseph—Moses—Rahab—What More Shall I Say?
how-to-manage-a-library: How to Manage a Library is a practical and spiritually-minded guide that provides a structured path for leaders to build, organize, and lead libraries with excellence and a commitment to community transformation.
humility-2: Andrew Murray explores the profound wisdom of humility, countering self-promotion in a world obsessed with it. He reveals humility’s three motives: as creatures, sinners, and saints, drawing inspiration from heavenly hosts, Jesus, and God’s grace. Murray challenges misconceptions, emphasizing humility as participation in Christ’s life and the highest fulfillment of our destiny. Contents: The Glory of The Creature—The Secret of Redemption—Humility in the Life of Jesus—Humility in the Teaching of Jesus—Humility in the Disciples of Jesus—Humility in the Daily Life—Humility and Holiness—Humility and Sin—Humility and Faith—Humility and Death to Self —Humility and Happiness—Humility and Exaltation—A Prayer for Humility.
if: IF, is a heartfelt devotional in which Amy Carmichael uses a series of probing “ifs” to reveal how easily the heart falls short of Christ-like love. Born from deep personal reflection, the book challenges readers to examine hidden motives and measure their lives against the self-giving love of the Cross. Yet its message is full of hope, pointing to God’s grace as the source of true transformation and deeper love.
let-us-pray-2: “Let Us Pray” offers profound insights into the art of prayer, guiding Christians to a vibrant, intimate prayer life. Watchman Nee explores various approaches, empowering readers to unlock prayer’s full potential and experience divine intervention. Contents: What is Prayer—Pray According to God’s Will—Prayer and God’s Work—The Principle of Praying Thrice —Prayer That Resists Satan—Some Pointers on Prayer—The Wearing-out Tactics of Satan.
lord-teach-us-to-pray-2: Prayer is the essence of a genuine relationship with God, the conduit for blessings, and the source of power and life. Effective prayer requires praying in the Spirit, and learning this skill is crucial. Following the disciples’ example, acknowledging our limitations, and trusting in the Spirit, we unlock the blessed secret of prayer, finding everlasting joy in communion with God. Contents: Lord, Teach Us to Pray—in Spirit and Truth—pray to Your Father Who is in Secret—after This Manner Pray.
men-and-women-who-gave-everything-2: “What does it truly cost to follow Jesus?” you may ask. This devotional study brings you face-to-face with ten legendary figures who answered that call without counting the price. From William Carey’s decades in India to Jim Elliot’s ultimate sacrifice, discover the raw, apostolic faith that shook nations.
men-of-prayer-2: Men of Prayer: Fifteen Voices That Changed the World calls pastors, teachers, and Christian leaders in Uganda back to the secret place of power. Through the lives of fifteen men whose prayers shaped history, this book reveals how God works through humble and persistent intercession.
men-who-moved-heaven: Ever wondered how men shifted the course of history without earthly wealth or worldly power? This book reveals their secret: the engine of prayer. From Spurgeon’s “boiler room” to George Müller’s miracles, discover how these warriors moved the hand of God. If you hunger for a faith that transcends the surface, let these legends mentor you in the art of intercession.
men-who-tended-the-flock-2: Discover the raw, biblical heart of the pastoral calling: feeding the hungry, seeking the lost, and guarding the flock. Whether you are a seasoned leader or a curious seeker, these stories will ignite a deeper love for the Good Shepherd and His people.
purity-of-heart: Can a heart truly be made pure—free from sin, full of love, and wholly devoted to God? In Purity of Heart, William Booth unfolds the path to inner cleansing, holy living, and spiritual victory. With clarity and urgency, he calls believers to deeper surrender and lasting transformation. Step into this life-changing message—and pursue the purity your soul was made for.
rise-up-men-of-god-2: Rise Up, Men of God is a compelling biblical call to spiritual leadership for the men of Uganda and East Africa. Drawing from Scripture, church history, and everyday life, this inspiring book equips men to lead their families, churches, and communities with faith, courage, humility, and purpose.
soar-like-the-eagle-3: This book reveals the hurdles hindering believers from reaching their spiritual potential. Explore the reasons many falter, learn six steps toward fulfilling your destiny in Christ, and embrace the abundant life, soaring on the winds of the Spirit. Contents: Flying High—Love Gifts—Doing It God’s Way—Reaching Your Destiny—Vision—Burden—Giftings—Ministry—Anointing—Flying—How To Release Your People—Being Released.
stepping-stones-2: Gareth Evans reflects on over fifty years of walking with the Lord, revealing how God guided his path through teaching, missionary work, and ministry. Through engaging stories, Evans illustrates the profound impact of faith, obedience, and divine intervention, encouraging readers to recognize and trust in God’s plan for their lives. Contents: Stepping Stones—The Journey Begins—I Will Go Before You—The Pearl of the Orient —Opportunities Abound—Jehovah Jireh – Our Provider —The Letter of Standing —The Application—My Word Shall Not Return Void—Faith – a Sovereign Gift—Hazel Glen Fellowship —God’s Broken Heart—A Call to Africa —Touching Our Roots —Opening Doors.
talks-to-the-farmer: Have you ever wondered how the ordinary scenes of farm life can reveal deep spiritual truths? In Talks to the Farmer, Charles Spurgeon draws vivid lessons from seeds, soil, labour, and harvest, turning everyday rural life into profound reflections on repentance, grace, and the work of God in the heart. Open these pages and let their timeless wisdom challenge, encourage, and nourish your faith.
the-body-of-christ-a-reality: Step into a profound exploration of the body of Christ with Watchman Nee’s enlightening volume. Drawing from years of faithful ministry, Nee unveils the living reality of the church as the body of Christ. Through carefully selected messages, he reveals that this body is not just a concept but a vibrant life founded on a living relationship with its head and governed by unique laws. Discover the wisdom and strength for a life immersed in the reality of the body of Christ. Contents: Life and Consciousness—The Consciousness of the Body of Christ—Hold Fast the Head—The Service of the Member—The Function and Harmony of the Members—Obeying the Law of the Body of Christ.
the-body-of-christ-teens: In a world that often tells you to “be yourself,” “stand alone,” and “be self-made,” it is easy to think of your faith as a private, individual journey. However, the Christian life was never meant to be lived in isolation. God is not simply looking for impressive individuals; He is recovering a living Body.
the-christians-secret-of-a-happy-life-4: Have you been longing to experience true happiness? The Christian Secret of a Happy Life is a transformative guide for Christians seeking lasting joy. If you struggle to surrender your worries and yearn for God’s guidance, this book is filled with practical insights and biblical wisdom to help you overcome doubt, find peace, and cultivate a deeper, more fulfilling relationship with God.
the-god-of-all-comfort: Why do so many Christians carry their faith like a heavy burden rather than a source of rest? In this timeless classic, Hannah Whitall Smith strips away the exhausting layers of religious effort to reveal the true character of God. She invites you to move beyond a “rollercoaster” spiritual life and settle into the quiet, steady confidence that comes from simply taking God at His word. Discover a peace that remains unshaken.
the-inner-chamber: The Inner Chamber leads readers on a profound spiritual journey, stressing the importance of relying on God’s wisdom over human understanding. Through biblical insights, it reveals that true understanding comes from a humble heart guided by the Holy Spirit.
the-key-in-my-hand: This book delves into transformative teachings on priorities, covenant relationships, and the Body of Christ. Unveil the tragic reality of strained connections, expose Satan’s devices, and explore the healing process through forgiveness and release. Encounter true stories of miraculous transformations and practical guidance for personal healing. Contents: A Covenant People—The Body of Christ—The Tragic Truth—The Devices of Satan—Unneeded Baggage—The Rock of Offense—The Wounded Soul—Our Response—The Key to Release—Heaven is Opened—Jesus – The Healer—Walking Out Your Healing.
the-masters-indwelling: In “The Master’s Indwelling,” Andrew Murray guides readers to transform their lives by inviting Christ in, yielding to the Holy Spirit, and escaping the roots of bondage. The book addresses key aspects like overcoming carnality, waiting on God, and seeking His kingdom, offering insights on complete surrender, peace, comfort in God’s grace, and the profound dwelling of God within. Contents: The Master’s Indwelling—Carnal Christians—The Self-life—Waiting on God—Entrance Into Rest—The Kingdom First—Christ Our Life—Christ’s Humility – Our Salvation—The Complete Surrender—Dead With Christ—Joy in the Holy Ghost—Triumph of Faith—The Source of Power in Prayer—That God May Be All in All.
the-normal-christian-life: “The Normal Christian Life” explores living as a true Christian, emphasizing Christ’s indwelling, forgiveness, victory through His blood, the transformative power of the Cross, and the crucial role of the Holy Spirit. Contents: The Blood of Christ—The Cross—The Path of Progress: Knowing—The Path of Progress: Reckoning—The Divide of the Cross—The Path of Progress: Presenting Ourselves to God—The Eternal Purpose—The Holy Spirit—The Meaning and Value of Romans Seven—The Path of Progress: Bearing the Cross—The Goal of the Gospel.
the-person-and-work-of-the-holy-spirit: The Person and Work of the Holy Spirit is a foundational work in Christian theology. The book systematically presents the Holy Spirit not as a mere influence, but as a distinct and divine person within the Trinity. Torrey carefully details the Holy Spirit’s multifaceted work in a believer’s life, including regeneration, sanctification, and empowerment for ministry.
the-secret-of-guidance: The Secret of Guidance by Frederick Brotherton Meyer is a timeless guide to discerning God’s will and finding lasting purpose. With heartfelt wisdom and practical advice, Meyer offers clarity in tough decisions, comfort in uncertainty, and a deeper connection to faith. This inspiring book explores strengthening the inner self and aligning with divine intentions for a fulfilling life. Perfect for those seeking spiritual growth and guidance. Contents: The Secret of Guidance—Where Am I Wrong?—The Secret of Christ’s indwelling—Fact! Faith! Feeling—Burdens, and What to Do with Them—How to Bear Sorrow—In the Secret of His Presence—The Fullness of the Spirit.
the-unselfishness-of-god: For anyone seeking a deeper understanding of God’s nature and a more authentic spiritual life, The Unselfishness of God by Hannah Whitall Smith offers profound insight. Through her personal journey of doubt, struggle, and revelation, you will discover a God whose love is entirely selfless and compassionate.
women-who-moved-heaven-2: Have you ever wondered how women changed the course of history from quiet rooms and tear-stained benches? This book reveals their secret: the power of persistent prayer. From Monica’s seventeen-year intercession to Corrie ten Boom’s faith in a concentration camp, discover how these warriors held heaven open.
